mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, u.username, p.name AS product_name, op.quantity, op.unit_price, op.quantity * op.unit_price AS subtotal FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id INNER JOIN order_products op ON op.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = op.product_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY op.id ASC
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email, ic.card_number, ic.real_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN id_cards ic ON ic.user_id = u.id ORDER BY u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, o.order_no, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at AS order_time FROM orders o RIGHT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id ORDER BY u.id ASC, o.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.id DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(p.id, op.product_id) AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, op.id AS order_product_id, op.order_id, op.quantity, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 'ORPHAN_ORDER_PRODUCT' WHEN op.id IS NULL THEN 'UNSOLD_PRODUCT' ELSE 'MATCHED' END AS match_status FROM products p FULL OUTER JOIN order_products op ON op.product_id = p.id ORDER BY COALESCE(p.id, op.product_id) ASC, op.id ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS product_price FROM users u CROSS JOIN products p ORDER BY u.id ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, latest.order_no, latest.total_amount, latest.status, latest.created_at AS order_time FROM users u LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.order_no, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at, o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE ORDER BY u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, stats.order_count, stats.total_spent FROM users u INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ) stats ON stats.user_id = u.id ORDER BY stats.total_spent DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email FROM users u WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id ) ORDER BY u.id ASC
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id ) ORDER BY u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= #{minOrderCount} ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.id ASC

SELECT id AS user_id, username, email, status FROM users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT id AS user_id, username, email, status FROM users WHERE status <> 'ACTIVE' OR status IS NULL ORDER BY user_id ASC
SELECT id AS order_id, order_no, status, CASE status WHEN 'PAID' THEN '已支付' WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待支付' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM orders ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, order_no, status FROM orders ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id AS user_id, username, email, COALESCE(phone, '未填写') AS phone FROM users ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id AS user_id, username, created_at, created_at::date AS create_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)::int AS create_year FROM users ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, stats.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY stats.total_spent DESC, u.id ASC) AS rank FROM users u INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ) stats ON stats.user_id = u.id ORDER BY rank ASC

WITH user_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username ) SELECT user_id, username, order_count, total_spent, CASE WHEN total_spent >= 20000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_spent >= 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS spending_level FROM user_stats ORDER BY total_spent DESC, user_id ASC

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, COALESCE(SUM(op.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(op.quantity * op.unit_price), 0) AS total_sales, p.stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_products op ON op.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.stock ORDER BY total_sales DESC, p.id ASC
